method_name: Three-stage cascade U-Transformer weather forecasting system
definition: A forecasting pipeline that uses three specialized transformer-based spatiotemporal models in cascade across increasing lead-time ranges to reduce autoregressive error accumulation and extend forecasts to 15 days.
assumptions: The provided workspace contains inference artifacts rather than full trainable pipeline assets.
Evaluation may need to focus on consistency of provided forecasts with the described method rather than full retraining.
invariants: Global multivariate meteorological inputs from two consecutive 6-hour states
Forecast horizon extends to 15 days at 6-hour resolution
Cascade structure uses specialized submodels for different lead-time regimes
Assessment should be lead-time aware due to error accumulation concerns
non_negotiable_structural_steps: Analyze outputs across lead time rather than single aggregated endpoint
Make any deviation from full three-model cascade implementation explicit
current_fidelity_status: Workspace currently appears suitable for artifact-level evaluation, not full reproduction of training and inference stack.
